cards.title: 37 newer heroes, your notes
cards.text: Every showcase 3 note is built: three heroes redone, 20 new traits, eight new statuses. Live as 0.19.0.
cards.why: One card a hero follows, with a clip for each thing that changed. This card is the summary and the things I want your call on.
cards.details:
Redone from scratch: the Bandit (he takes things off enemies), the Beekeeper (bees that stay and pester), the Quartermaster (no potions; supplies and a barricade).

Roles changed: the Valkyrie is a support now; the Chef, the Trapper and the Engineer fight at range.

Balance, measured at tier I and III: tanks deal 23-24% of a party's damage, shooters 41-42%, supports 18-20%. Still strong: the Beekeeper, the Chef, the Valkyrie and the Shaman at tier I (healers again), the Pirate at tier III. Weakest: the Seer at tier I, the Griffon at tier III.

parts.title: New statuses
parts.text: Whirled, Dirty, Targeted, Tracked, Trapped and Weakened as you described them. The Monk's turning effect I named Spun. For the Alchemist's protection status my answer is Warded: a pale blue border.

parts.title: Shackled: not yet
parts.text: You said it should go to someone else, maybe the executioner. It waits for that hero.

parts.title: Bulwark: a question
parts.text: Hybrid damage tank is built as Return Thrust (blows he takes wind up a piercing thrust). Brace, Shield Wall and Impale are unchanged: say if hybrid should reach those too.

parts.title: Props drawn in code
parts.text: The new summons and props (totem, cauldron, pavise, beehive, barricade, turrets) are plain shapes for now, and a few weapons need to be separate parts. They are on the art list.

parts.title: Six new heroes: not built
parts.text: The six new heroes from your deck notes (the Warden and the others) are not built yet.

items.label: Parry
items.text: "Should have a parry ability. The next attack is blocked and deflected back if it was a projectile, melee just go back to target. When leveled up gets 2 charges. Maybe instead of pommel strike" Built: Parry in Pommel Strike's slot : 4 s on guard (the greatsword drawn across him, a glint running along it); the next blow is caught and its force goes back into the striker, the next shot flies back at its shooter. I one, II two, III twice as hard.

items.label: Rally
items.text: Rally: "Get a haste boost when leveled up. Effect remains for a little bit." Built: II: haste (30% faster moves and blows) and the whole rally lasts 8 s (was 5).

items.label: Trait: Last Stand
items.text: Trait: "Trait should be last stand. When last one in party gets a long unstoppable and haste buff, all abilities are reset." Built: Last Stand : once a room, when the last of his side falls: Unstoppable (its gold border) and haste for 10 s, every cooldown reset, a gold burst. Book scene added.

cards.details: Pommel Strike's note ("Shackled status effect"): goes with the shackled idea to a later hero (above).
